text: 20 Laurel opened her eyes as Brian began to speak and discovered that Dinah’s head was in her lap. She stroked her hair gently and then readjusted her position on the stretcher. “This is Captain Engle, folks. I’m sorry about that. It was pretty damned hairy, but we’re okay; I’ve got a green board. Let me repeat that we’ve found what we were looking for, but—” He clicked off suddenly. The others waited. Bethany Simms was sobbing against Albert’s chest. Behind them, Rudy was still saying the rosary.
